correctness.rationale: The frozen package reconstructs the published three \(2\times2\) minors. On \(P_\gamma=V(\gamma_2,\gamma_4,\gamma_5)\), the first quadratic row vanishes identically and direct differentiation leaves only the \(\gamma_5\) Jacobian column; hence the defining Jacobian has rank at most one. The symmetric statement holds on \(P_\delta\), with only the \(\delta_0\) column. Since the ambient product has dimension ten, the published prime variety has dimension eight, and these product subsets have dimension seven, every such point is singular and the singular locus has a divisor, violating regularity in codimension one and therefore normality. At a general double-line point, the differential of the zero row has rank three and composition with wedge against a nonzero other row has rank two, so the codimension-two variety is smooth there. An independent symbolic reconstruction reproduced the one-column restrictions and an explicit Jacobian rank-one witness; the argument itself is symbolic and global on the stated plane.

value.rationale: Normality is a basic structural property of a multiview variety, and a codimension-one singular boundary materially affects normalization and downstream intersection/birational calculations. Isolating the epipolar reducible-conic component as the source of the defect while distinguishing the generically smooth double-line component is a motivated geometric result, not merely a consistency check of the published equations.
residual_risks: A later or differently indexed singularity study of the same conic multiview variety could contain the same normality defect.

final_claim: For the two-view conic multiview variety, the epipolar reducible-conic planes in either image factor produce codimension-one singular subvarieties \(P_\gamma\times\mathbb P^5\) and \(\mathbb P^5\times P_\delta\); hence the irreducible variety is nonnormal, while a general double-line point in the other zero-row component is smooth. The conclusion is invariant under projective coordinate changes for any distinct-center camera pair.
scientific_limitations: A later or differently indexed singularity study of the same conic multiview variety could contain the same normality defect.
